page_title: ARS 0-0 LIV | Arsenal v Liverpool 08/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Gabriel (Arsenal), but it's just wide of the left post.
90+6' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) will take a corner kick.
90+5' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) is substituted due to injury. Arne Slot gives a chance to Joe Gomez.
90+3' It's like he was asking for a caution. Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) receives a yellow card.
90+3' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Anthony Taylor pulls out a yellow card.
90+2' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+2' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) commits a foul and Anthony Taylor immediately signals a free kick.
90+1' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Alisson makes a comfortable save.
90+1' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) receives a yellow card!
88' Shots on target – 2:0.
85' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
83' Mikel Arteta appears to have said too much and referee Anthony Taylor comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
82' A superb shot by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar.
80' A pass by Noni Madueke (Arsenal) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
78' Mikel Arteta decides to make a substitution. Martin Odegaard will be replaced by Eberechi Eze (Arsenal).
78' Bukayo Saka comes off the pitch to be replaced by Noni Madueke (Arsenal).
77' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
76' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
74' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) tries to find Myles Lewis-Skelly, but he puts too much power on the pass.
68' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) picks up an injury.
66' A pass by Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
64' The referee signals a substitution. Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) is brought on as a substitute for Viktor Gyökeres.
64' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) replacing Leandro Trossard.
64' The foul by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) was seen by Anthony Taylor who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
64' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
62' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) attempts to beat the keeper from the resulting set piece, but his lazy shot sails several yards wide of the right post.
61' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle after Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
60' The Liverpool players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
57' Piero Hincapie is being substituted because of an injury. Mikel Arteta sends Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) on the pitch.
57' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) sprays a pass out to Martin Zubimendi, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
51' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) tries to find Florian Wirtz, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
48' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
47' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) inside the box.
44' Declan Rice (Arsenal) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the left side of the target, but Alisson keeps it out with an amazing save.
43' 60:40 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
42' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) is penalised for a foul. Anthony Taylor had a clear view and blows his whistle.
42' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jurrien Timber (Arsenal), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
39' A pass by Declan Rice (Arsenal) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
38' The corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is cleared away by the defence.
36' Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
36' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender. Arsenal force their opponents to concede a corner.
36' Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
33' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
32' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes a short free kick.
32' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) brings an opponent down and Anthony Taylor interrupts the game.

31' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
28' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
27' A rebound lands at the feet of Conor Bradley (Liverpool), whose promising strike from long range crashes against the crossbar! What an opportunity that was!
23' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
22' Arsenal are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
20' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
18' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Alisson makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
17' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is flagged for offside.
16' Good defending. Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) tries to find Martin Zubimendi inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
16' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
12' The foul by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Anthony Taylor.
12' Alisson comes off his line to intercept the corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal).
10' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
10' A pass from Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) is intercepted by Alisson and the move breaks down.
9' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
5' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
4' Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Liverpool will take the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor will officiate today.
